existing_findings.current_evidence: GarmentMesh 130–162 stores positions, triangles, edges, rest_lengths, bends, bend_weights, seams, masses; current Cloth::new 28–47 clones exactly these into ShellMesh, whose fields appear in shell/mesh.rs 10–18. candidate_findings.status: Source-backed conditional elaboration of historical tiny-edge/resource and current resolution obligations; central decides alias, count and supported target/resource policy.
candidate_findings.condition: On the x86_64 target represented by the recorded installed Rust reference, direct public cloth::build receives a nonempty simple finite triangular panel containing a unit-length edge and target_edge=f32::MIN_POSITIVE, with an otherwise admissible areal density. This is a conceptual source argument, not an executed fixture. The nonempty build checks only target<=0 and NaN, so this finite positive value passes.
candidate_findings.reasoning: A unit edge divided by the minimum positive normal f32 is about 8.5e37, above u64/usize maximum on the identified x86_64 target. The f32-to-usize cast saturates to usize::MAX per the preserved local Rust reference. build stores that as the edge subdivision count at garment/mod.rs:236–246. triangulate_with_segments receives the count and resample_boundary_with_segments evaluates Vec::with_capacity(segments + 1) at triangulate/mod.rs:166–184. If integer overflow checks are enabled, the addition fails before a structured mesh error; with checks disabled, downstream work/allocation consequences depend on environment and are not asserted. No meshing, allocation, test, fixture generation or runtime probe occurred.
candidate_findings.limits_and_reachability: The creator drape run calls selection.validate at drape.rs:37–45; the selection requires finite resolution within 2.5–6 cm at selection.rs:155–156,207–212. That excludes this tiny resolution on that path, though it does not alone establish global panel-size or work bounds. FitSettings and cloth::build remain public raw interfaces; no actual external bad caller, build profile or product failure was observed.
candidate_findings.future_direction: After supported work/resource and finite/unit policies are specified, validate or checked-convert subdivision and total vertex/constraint capacities before integer increment, allocations and native narrowing. Preserve ordinary finite resolutions, explicit empty output and structured errors. This is not a recommendation to accept unbounded +infinity or silently clamp counts.
candidate_findings.historical_alias_qualification: READ-L11-430 explicitly left tiny edge/huge grid and u32 narrowing open; q614 retains point-count obligations. REVIEW-CLOTH-POSITIVE-RESOLUTION-95E addressed +infinity and dependency/unit policy. These are related but exact same/different repair contract is unresolved, and no separate count is assigned.

nonfindings: Empty panel input returns default before checking target edge; this is a documented valid empty result, not an automatic invalid-state defect.
Seam endpoint references are checked before indexing counts, and chain lengths are checked at least 2 before dividing by stitches−1.

Interior bend and stretch rest geometry computed from placed positions agrees with flat geometry in exact arithmetic under a finite rigid rotation/translation; large finite coordinates and f32 precision remain separate open questions.
Actual selected creator drape entry validates its selected finite resolution range; that does not prove arbitrary external library callers or mesh-size limits.
Shell::new calls ShellMesh.validate before native particle creation; this later validation does not prove input was bounded during earlier triangulation.
GarmentMesh.panel names and offsets, material coordinates, and ShellMesh simulation geometry have related but distinct consumer purposes.
open_questions: What supported maximum subdivision, total vertex/constraint memory and native index policy should public cloth::build and triangulate honor?
What exact aliases connect tiny-resolution, +infinity, extreme finite panel coordinates, earlier q614 and native allocation/count contracts?
What are all actual public raw mesh mutation, panel index, empty mesh, Pivots association and downstream solver contracts? No arbitrary malformed request was run.

Do finite but extreme panel placements lose unacceptable precision when rest lengths are computed from translated f32 positions? Domain magnitude and error policy remain open, not a proven runtime failure.
How do triangulator topology, concavity, constraints and solver validation behave end-to-end? Unread ranges and native/device behavior remain unassessed.

lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.assessment: Pattern adapter samples panels, matches names to seam sides and forwards resolution/fabric density to cloth build; creator drape applies a separate bounded selection check. GarmentMesh then feeds Pivots and Cloth→ShellMesh, with separately scoped validation.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.assessment: ShellMesh already owns the eight shared geometry/constraint/mass vectors also stored by GarmentMesh; historical RIG-INITIAL06-F003 is directly reconnected, while panel/material provenance remains garment-specific.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.assessment: Nonempty build rejects nonpositive/NaN target and validates seam references but does not bound derived subdivision capacity. Empty panels return empty before that gate. ShellMesh later validates physical vectors; this does not bound the earlier meshing path.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.assessment: Current counts derive from f32 length/resolution then saturating cast to usize; triangulator computes segments+1 for capacity. Tiny positive finite resolution and ordinary finite panel edge can exceed representable count before allocation; detailed conditional source argument below.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.assessment: positions/material and per-panel offsets/names are parallel, and seam/triangle indices require consistency. build normally produces them together; raw public mesh and Pivots lack a sealed association, but no ordinary malformed caller is established.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.assessment: Panel, SeamSide and material coordinates own pattern-specific topology and original panel provenance; ShellMesh owns shared physical mesh record. Distinct geometric frames and typed density/mass are not blanket-interchangeable.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.assessment: GarmentMesh independently maintains shell-vector record copied into ShellMesh; preserve existing F003 as one ownership issue, not duplicate counts. Initial positions and material coordinates serve separate frames and cannot simply be collapsed.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.assessment: Assigned source bytes match 6533 and current 95e individually. This says nothing about the cleanliness of the old working snapshot, other source paths, execution or runtime behavior.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.assessment: Seam reversed encodes orientation of two stitched sides; its semantic owner is distinct from seam identity. Empty panels intentionally yield an empty mesh; absent seam pairs and skipped panels remain separate documented policies.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.assessment: GarmentMesh and panels have standard Clone/Debug/Default where declared; no manual trait or serialization replacement is proven by assigned source.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.assessment: Panel-local planar material coordinates and world positions, panel ordinals and particle indices, physical areal density, counts and continuous resolution have different owners and units. Positive-length type alone does not bound work or cardinality.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.assessment: Panel names are stored and propagated from pattern keys, but the inspected Pivots consumer uses ordinal ranges rather than name strings. Historical q316 and current panel identity/ambiguous stitch questions remain separate; do not invent a closed name namespace.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.assessment: Mesher count saturation, max(1), segment allocation and checked u32 representability require contextual resource policy. Geometric degeneracy epsilon and legitimate empty behavior are separate choices, not automatically replaced by an arbitrary newtype.
